en: A vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing three rural scenes of a small village. The top image features a church with a tall onion‑shaped tower rising above trees and farm buildings. The middle image shows a pond in the foreground with reflections of trees and a large house or manor on the opposite bank. The bottom image depicts a dirt road leading between trees and traditional village houses. At the top of the postcard is printed the caption identifying the village.
